note: South of Lake Louise village on the east bank of the Bow River, alongside the Canadian Pacific rail line. Hard-sided units only: anything with soft sides or pop-outs must use the separate soft-sided section across the river, which is the part inside the electric fence. Sites are shared double-length pads; some have no firepit. --Claude
